name: chain1
author: ghjob360
tagline: a one-voice synth in a fixed chain: OSC, FILTER, EG, MOD, DELAY, REVERB, ARP
description: One voice through a fixed chain - four oscillators (saw, triangle, square, 2-op phase modulation) with their own LFO, a 2/4-pole state-variable filter with a sweep, five envelope types with tremolo, chorus/ensemble/phaser/flanger, five delays, five reverbs and a ten-pattern arpeggiator. Its layout follows a well-known pocket synth's signal flow; the DSP is original.
